title: Cups in tarot: court card meanings
description: Page, Knight, Queen and King of Cups in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how to read court cards as people, parts of yourself or approaches.

scenes.headline: Cups in tarot: court card meanings
scenes.caption: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Cups bring the sensitivity of water to a tarot spread. Court cards can be people, parts of yourself or ways of approaching a situation.
scenes.vo: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Cups bring the sensitivity of water to a tarot spread. Court cards can be people, parts of yourself or ways of approaching a situation.

scenes.headline: Page of Cups
scenes.caption: Curiosity, tenderness, creative messages. The Page stands by the sea holding a cup from which a small fish peeks out.
scenes.vo: Page of Cups. Curiosity, tenderness, creative messages. The Page stands by the sea holding a cup from which a small fish peeks out.

scenes.headline: Knight of Cups
scenes.caption: Romance, invitation, following the heart. The Knight rides a calm horse, holding out a cup. Unlike the Knight of Wands, this rider moves steadily rather than at speed.
